# MySentry

> Live Safe. Stay Healthy.

MySentry connects supported safety alerts, trusted contacts, permitted incident context, wellness-signal analysis, and eligible 24/7 professional monitoring across supported phones and wearable configurations. Available Panic Alarm triggers may include the app, phone shake, supported button actions, a supported smartwatch, or a configured voice command.

During an eligible online Panic Alarm, MySentry can share live location, phone battery level, and permitted phone audio or video when enabled. Configured family members and responders can use supported iOS or Android phones. The professional monitoring team can review the event and, after verification, contact emergency services, including 911, when appropriate.

## Setup and Limitations

- A currently supported smartphone is required. Optional wearable features require an eligible device and supported configuration.
- Required permissions vary by feature and may include notifications, location, motion, background activity, microphone, camera, or contacts.
- Alert delivery and shared context require an available supported device and network connection.
- Feature behavior depends on the active plan, device, software, settings, permissions, app state, connectivity, region, third parties, and service availability.
- Supported wellness information is non-medical and is not used to diagnose, predict, treat, or prevent a condition.
- Review current pricing, eligibility, and plan terms at https://mysentry.ai/pricing before enrollment.
